references.text: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary sat facing the tomb after Jesus' burial, setting the scene for their visit at the beginning of chapter 28.
Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of James, buy spices to go and anoint Jesus' body, showing parallels in the accounts of the women visiting the tomb.
Women, including Mary Magdalene, visit the tomb with spices they have prepared, illustrating a parallel event.
Mary Magdalene comes to the tomb early and finds the stone removed, a parallel to the event in Matthew.
